name: death-back
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT BACK-view DEATH/CORPSE sequence, exactly FOUR COMPLETE poses in a 2x2 SQUARE grid, preferably 1536x1536. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Camera stays behind the zombie, only rear head/hair/back tunic visible, NO face/eyes/chest. Frame 1: upright back-facing zombie reels with buckling knees, head-to-sole standing height about 450px. Frame 2: collapses into low kneeling slump, shoulders sinking. Frame 3: falls onto side on ground, head toward RIGHT and shoes toward LEFT, back of tunic/hair toward camera. Frame 4: final motionless corpse flat across ground, same head-right/shoes-left direction, back toward camera, limp arms/extended legs. SAME anatomical scale and limb lengths all frames: lower/wider corpse NOT enlarged to standing height. Whole body/hands/boots within own cell, corpse length at most560px and very generous transparent gutters especially between rows. No blood pool, floor, effect, ghost or resurrection. Upper figures end above halfway, lower figures entirely below halfway.
